Message:
ALSA: hda/realtek - ALC287 I2S speaker platform support

0x17 was only speaker pin, DAC assigned will be 0x03. Headphone
assigned to 0x02.
Playback via headphone will get EQ filter processing. So,it needs to
swap DAC.
